name: Glyphic Memorandum
summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Glyphic Memorandum sends novice mages to Anvilmar. Marryk Nurribit wrote it to guide arriving spellcasters into formal arcane instruction.

sections.title: A Summons to Anvilmar
sections.body: Novice spellcasters receive the Glyphic Memorandum after finishing their first tasks in Coldridge Valley. Marryk Nurribit, the local mage trainer, calls them inside Anvilmar. His advice is plain: learn your incantations, save coin for training and tavern ale, and keep clear of Gnomeregan, ruined by radiation.

faq.answer: The Glyphic Memorandum is a short summons for newly arrived mages in Coldridge Valley. It directs them to the arcane trainer inside Anvilmar.
Marryk Nurribit wrote the memorandum. He trains mages in Anvilmar, in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What advice does the trainer give when answering the memorandum?
faq.answer: When you present the note, Marryk advises restraint. Save coin for spells and tavern ale, and avoid Gnomeregan's radioactive halls.

angles.text: As a mage in Dun Morogh, you begin your formal arcane apprenticeship under Marryk Nurribit with this note.
As a gnome mage starting your journey in exile, your trainer urges you to focus on your studies and stay away from Gnomeregan, your lost homeland.
